n97cc247b6d.headline: This News Publisher Quit Facebook. Readership Went Up
n97cc247b6d.summary: New Zealand's biggest news publisher left Facebook and subsequently saw an increase in readership.
n97cc247b6d.why: This development highlights changing dynamics in digital media distribution and monetization strategies for publishers.

n42caab4a90.headline: There is not enough cash - why is the National Bank silent?
n42caab4a90.summary: Kazakhstan experiences a shortage of small denomination bills, with retail businesses refusing cash and banks charging high commissions for breaking large bills amid growing cashless payment adoption.
n42caab4a90.why: Cash shortages and shifts to cashless payments affect retail operations, consumer behavior, and banking sector dynamics.

n51c31d1ff8.why: Government incentives for EVs promote clean energy adoption and can stimulate automotive and energy sectors locally.
